notes.title: Charged Blocks Power Up Guns + Shields
notes.content: Bullets that strike a block’s metal surface now apply a 3-second charge. Any charged block breaks on a same-color melee hit—even metal. This is a significant power boost for Electric Guns and Shields, hopefully bringing them in line with Sabers. Several related systems have been updated as well.

notes.title: Lightning VFX + More SFX
notes.content:
This update adds some eye-catching lightning effects to the gun and shields, making each shot and hit feel a bit more intense. You’ll also hear a range of new sounds throughout the game—from the electric hiss of the shields to new collision sounds for the bullets. More sounds are on the way soon!

notes.title: Improved Pitched Note Tracking + Weapon Switching
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269093/6f86580485dfbd33f085e1332791a9fcbf7da5bc.jpg[/img]

The arrows indicate the note breaks within the contours (visible as the bright spots within the note' pitch contours / where they change color on note breaks).

Nothing too fancy in this update. Mostly I've rebalanced a few minor difficulty attributes and focused on improving the audio analysis of the cent (full-sized piano) scale. In particular, I've significantly improved detection of note changes within larger note contours (individual notes, and/or phoneme changes within note phases, and/or slurred words). It's still a work in progress (WIP). 

This update also includes a substantial number of small bug fixes for weapon switching, along with numerous other minor bug fixes too long to list here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269093/dd8c03adc6485e34ef2fbc5d2c5a758a904ca7db.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Added HDRI Backgrounds
notes.content: I added a number of HDRI static cloud backgrounds for when volumetric clouds are turned off.

notes.title: Added basic difficulty presets
notes.content: This week's biggest update is a new "basic" panel for difficulty settings with 6 difficulty presets - Easy / Normal / Expert / Expert+ / Elder Sage. You can switch between the basic and advanced difficulty setting at the top of the main Leveling panel. These are still largely untested presets so send me feedback on them. From the in-person testing session I tested them on this week, my current feeling is that the Novice / Normal difficulties have a bit too low default attack rates for a lot of songs... I've already started investigating setting a per-song floor for attach rate so it can't drop below the song's primary BPM.  I'll also be focusing on making the levels have a lot less horizontal spread for where they place blocks in next few weeks too.

notes.title: Holsters Update
notes.content:
In this update, I've added fixes for weapon holster switching issues from the last few weeks. 

1) Input detection for the drop-to-swap mode has been added (when not holding a weapon). Previously, if you were not holding a weapon, the switch wouldn't initiate. Now, you can summon the weapon with a grip pull even when your hand is empty. 

2) There is an ongoing bug causing holsters to sometimes drop weapons on level reloads, which I haven't fully tracked down yet. To avoid delaying the patch, I've added temporary code to auto-detect and fix these issues when the level finishes loading. This means the bug should only persist for a brief moment during level loading.

Coming Up) I'll be working on further improvements to address issues when switching between drop-to-swap and sticky press (4 holster) modes over the next week or so.

Thank you all for your patience and the feedback you've provided!

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content: This week, I focused primarily on graphics performance. Last week, I attempted a significant move to Vulkan/DX12, but ultimately reverted to DX11 due to its more consistent execution times compared to the newer APIs. The transition involved substantial rewrites to the custom particle physics package I developed for the game. Overall, graphics performance should be improved by 20-40% over the previous release.

notes.title: Beta - Day 1 Patch
notes.content: This week I got selected is the jury, and then as the foreman of that jury on a rape trial.  The only major additions from the past couple weeks is a new dialogue window where you can paste in links to songs on your computer, or Internet in general and play them immediately w/o requiring organizing a full personal music library.  The copied links do need to the direct media like a .mp3, not embedded media like YouTube.  I also fixed a lot of other random bug fixes.
